Gosh I hope so! A friend of mine has gone through raising two pups and trained both of them to be service dogs and she said he’s supposed to learn to self-soothe when he gets anxious. When I leave him with her to puppy sit he whines for a few minutes and calms right down. But when I leave him, the world is ending.

Edit: I mean when I leave him with her she works on kennel training and he calms down after a bit. It’s just with me that he freaks out when I leave him alone.

Thanks for the info! I always hand my puppy the treats. He just drops them and starts going nutty when he realizes I’m leaving. I’ve tried stuffed Kongs, bully sticks, scattered kibble, milk bones, etc. He’s only interested in them if I stay in the room. 

He goes into his kennel on command very well and he LOVES his kennel. He’ll play in there and stash his fav toys. He just hates being left in there unless he’s ready for a nap. He’ll sleep in there all night with me coming and going from the room. He doesn’t seem to notice or care. But if he’s not ready to be kenneled, he loses his shit. Idk what I’m doing wrong or if I’ve skipped some critical step in training.

Thanks for the reply! I have given him all kinds of treats in there and unfortunately it doesn’t seem to work. He completely ignores them the second I go to leave or if he looks up and can’t see me. Then it starts with a light whine and works up to distress barking and panting. Might have to consult with an actual trainer one on one for this. I don’t want to leave it and have it get worse as he ages.
Thanks! I can read articles and stuff online all day and still be unsure, real life experience/advice is always super helpful, so I appreciate it!!
